definitions.explanation: A table that lists two or more sets of items side by side so they can be compared or matched, such as a conversion or correspondence chart.

examples.japanese: {新旧|しんきゅう}の{対照表|たいしょうひょう}。
examples.english: A comparison table of old and new.

examples.japanese: サイズの{対照表|たいしょうひょう}を{見|み}る。
examples.english: Look at a size correspondence table.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}と{英語|えいご}の{単語|たんご}の{対照表|たいしょうひょう}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made a comparison table of Japanese and English words.

notes:
Formed from {対照|たいしょう} (contrast, comparison) + {表|ひょう} (table, chart). Presents items side by side for matching.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新旧|しんきゅう}{対照表|たいしょうひょう}: old-vs-new comparison table
- サイズ{対照表|たいしょうひょう}: size conversion table

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {比較表|ひかくひょう}: comparison table — emphasizes weighing options; {対照表|たいしょうひょう} emphasizes matching corresponding items
